scope: Sixteenth bounded target-specific wave: seven current completion-unproved Health and Clinical targets; four direct OpenMRS benchmark recommendations and three conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at the pinned official-source loci. Generic adjacency, configurability without the target domain, or a lower-level primitive is retained unproved.
methodology.absence_rule: A zero path-name result in a complete pinned repository tree is candidate rejection evidence only and never a global no-match claim.

project_catalogue.selection: Pinned official OpenMRS community repositories already present in the 97-project catalogue.

OPENMRS_PATIENT_CHART.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted implementations, private configuration, commercial services and unpinned behavior are excluded.

OPENMRS_PATIENT_MANAGEMENT.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted implementations, private configuration, commercial services and unpinned behavior are excluded.

OPENMRS_CORE.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted implementations, private configuration, commercial services and unpinned behavior are excluded.

OPENMRS_FHIR2.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted implementations, private configuration, commercial services and unpinned behavior are excluded.
OPENMRS_FHIR2.tree_query_evidence: Complete recursive tree contained zero paths matching careplan (case-insensitive); this rejects this pinned candidate only and is not NCM completion evidence.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Maintain a patient-scoped register of typed clinical assessments with list, add, view, edit, delete, empty, loading and paginated states.
evaluations.reason: The configurable encounter-type register is patient-scoped, loads a typed form definition, lists and paginates records, launches add/view/edit/delete actions, refreshes after save, and exposes loading and empty states. This is a direct neutral behavior benchmark for an assessment register without importing OpenMRS implementation or UI.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Maintain a clinically governed behaviour-event register with the behavior-specific fields, risk/support context, lifecycle and access boundaries required by supported-living care.
evaluations.research_candidate: openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart generic EncounterList at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The generic encounter register can be configured for a form but the inspected source does not prove behavior-event semantics, antecedent/response/consequence context, risk/support linkage, behavior-specific lifecycle or governed review. Generic configurability is insufficient for direct credit and no bounded multi-repository NCM packet was completed.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Present care plans through a review lens that exposes review status, due/overdue timing, accountable owner and safe navigation to the canonical plan.
evaluations.research_candidate: openmrs/openmrs-module-fhir2 complete pinned tree and openmrs patient-chart generic dashboard/register loci
evaluations.reason: The complete pinned FHIR2 tree contains no CarePlan path, and the patient-chart dashboard/register primitives do not prove a care-plan review status/due/owner lens. This is candidate rejection only; no global NCM claim or completion credit follows.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Show patient-specific longitudinal clinical observations with date range, reference ranges, interpretation, chart/table views, loading/empty behavior and non-lossy export affordances.
evaluations.research_candidate: openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-chart test-result trendline and resource at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The pinned source fetches observation-tree data by patient and concept, recursively resolves observation/reference-range interpretation, renders dated chart and tabular values, supports date range and loading/empty/error states, and exposes CSV/PNG/fullscreen controls. This directly benchmarks the neutral patient-trend job.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Compose a patient-scoped clinical dashboard from bounded widgets while passing canonical patient context and allowing configured dashboard views without duplicating domain owners.
evaluations.reason: The dashboard passes patient and patient UUID into configured extension slots, resolves view-specific titles and layout metadata, and composes bounded widgets without replacing their owners. This directly benchmarks the neutral clinical module dashboard composition job.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Compute and present clinically meaningful aggregate trends across an authorized population/cohort with metric definition, time window, denominator and safe drill-down.
evaluations.research_candidate: openmrs/openmrs-core CohortService at pinned loci and patient-chart patient-level trendline
evaluations.reason: OpenMRS core proves authorized cohort membership management and the patient chart proves individual trendlines, but neither inspected locus proves aggregate clinical trend computation, denominator/time-window semantics or authorized drill-down. Combining primitives cannot inherit direct target credit.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Provide a reusable clinical-record workflow context that searches people, returns stable patient identity/summary data and hands the selected patient into a bounded child workflow without implicit global state.
evaluations.research_candidate: openmrs/openmrs-esm-patient-management patient-search resource, result banner and reusable workspace at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The reusable workspace performs bounded patient search, returns stable patient identity and summary fields, supports non-navigation selection callbacks, and hands patient UUID/object plus child-workspace controls to the consuming workflow. This directly benchmarks the neutral context-API job while leaving Oblivion authorization and Site constraints native.
